paper_title: Novel bounds on decaying axionlike particle dark matter from the cosmic background
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper constrains axion-photon coupling g_agamma via decaying ALP DM contribution to the cosmic background (optical to X-ray). Constraints derived at 2 sigma (95% CL) over ma = 0.5 eV - 10^7 eV. Data points are approximate readings from Fig. 3 exclusion curve (CUBA model, cosmic axion decay); no numerical table is provided so values are estimated from the plot and the power-law slope g_agamma ~ (mac^2)^(-0.245) fitted in the appendix. Local DM density rho_sun = 0.42 GeV/cm^3 used (NFW halo). Excluded region is ABOVE the curve.
